description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3音乐视频提示词。

prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A 15-second photorealistic cinematic sci-fi scene. One young adult woman sits slightly reclined beside a circular cabin window above a luminous future city at night. The window stays screen-left, the woman center-right, and a small tray sits within reach on her right. Her knees extend beyond the seat edge and her booted feet rest lightly on the floor. Preserve her identity, hairstyle, clothing, boots, anatomy, and visible metallic prosthetic placement throughout. Her left hand holds one orange with its top already opened and most of its flesh eaten away, leaving an irregular cavity with torn membranes, collapsed pulp, scrape marks, wet juice highlights, and small remnants clinging to the rind. Her right hand holds a small spoon. One pair of wireless over-ear headphones rests on the tray. Begin outside the circular window, seeing distant city lights and the seated woman through the glass, and approach slowly. She studies the hollowed orange and begins one careful scrape along the inner rind while her left fingers stabilize the peel. [Shot 2] At 00:00.900, the camera cuts at the window frame to a matching interior angle on the same side of the woman, never moving through the glass. Preserve composition, screen direction, and the same uninterrupted wrist motion as the scrape continues. [Shot 3] At 00:01.800, the camera cuts to a close detail of both hands and the orange interior. The same scrape completes, gathering one small spoonful of remaining flesh with visible juice and pulp. Follow the spoon to her mouth. She parts her lips slightly, accepts it, withdraws the spoon, closes her mouth, makes a small chew, swallows quietly, and relaxes. No second scoop, broad smile, or exaggerated tasting reaction. [Shot 4] At 00:04.700, the camera cuts to a three-quarter view showing her face, hands, and tray. Looking down, she places the orange cavity-up on the tray, then lays the spoon beside it, preserving the exact post-scoop interior. Both objects remain there for the rest of the film. She exhales softly, notices the headphones, and with both hands grasps one earcup each. At 00:06.200, the camera tilts up slightly as she lifts them, opens the cups gently, lowers the headband onto her crown, seats both cushions over her ears, makes one small fingertip adjustment, and lets her hands descend toward her lap. Exterior ambience becomes muffled while city and cabin lighting remain unchanged. [Shot 5] At 00:07.800, the camera cuts to a close three-quarter composition of her face and one hand resting on her thigh. A mellow instrumental groove begins through the headphones from her listening perspective, about 90 BPM, with rounded bass, light percussion, and spacious synth texture. Her gaze rests softly downward. The camera tilts gently toward her resting hand as her index finger finds the beat with two small, tentative taps. [Shot 6] At 00:09.600, the camera cuts to her lap, lower legs, and boots, with part of her torso at the top of frame. One heel stays lightly planted while the forefoot lifts and settles in a tiny ankle motion; a slight lower-leg sway follows. The other foot joins a moment later with smaller motion. Her finger taps continue in rhythm. She does not look down. Keep believable heel and sole contact with normal gravity. Music continues seamlessly. [Shot 7] At 00:11.800, the camera cuts to a three-quarter seated medium-wide showing her face, hands, knees, and boots together, then pushes in very slightly. Finger taps and ankle motions continue without resetting. Her shoulders settle, chin dips gently with the beat, and she releases an easy breath. She closes her eyes briefly, then opens them slowly. A small closed-mouth smile begins to stay. Her head inclines slightly with delayed natural hair movement. The rhythm spreads subtly through her posture without becoming a dance routine. At 00:13.600, remain in the same shot, tilt up slightly, and ease back gently to include both the woman and the full circular window while keeping her hands and lower legs near the bottom of frame. Her eyes lift toward the distant city. Her closed-mouth smile becomes slightly clearer. Fingers and feet keep their small, uneven pulse. Hold this living image through 00:15.000 as distant air traffic glides outside. No fade or freeze-frame. Maintain one woman, one orange, one spoon, and one pair of headphones only. Remove only the single shown spoonful; never restore the orange to a pristine half. Preserve hand assignments during eating, visible release contact when placing props down, and both hands' involvement in putting on the headphones. Headphones remain worn afterward; orange and spoon stay separate on the tray. Use natural perspective, stable facial proportions, soft background separation, and gentle camera movement. Keep all interior shots on the same side of the woman. Cuts must preserve gesture phase, posture, object state, and spatial orientation. Use soft cool window light on her window-facing cheek and hands, with dim warm cabin fill. Preserve natural skin texture, moist fruit, fine spoon reflections, and restrained prosthetic highlights. Lock exposure and lighting direction. Distant building lights shift subtly; cabin indicators pulse very slowly without changing room illumination. Neither city nor cabin lighting syncs to the music. Exclude dialogue, lyrics, narration, subtitles, watermarks, extra characters, extra props, repeated scooping, restored orange flesh, identity drift, altered prosthetic placement, malformed anatomy, wrong hand contact, intersecting objects, floating feet, exaggerated chewing, wide grins, repeated blinking, mechanical full-body synchronization, unmotivated cuts, abrupt zooms, or camera passage through glass.

overall_soundscape: Quiet ventilation, distant traffic, delicate spoon scraping, soft tray contact, headphone handling, and natural breathing establish the cabin. As the ear cushions seal, exterior ambience becomes muffled. At 00:07.800, the headphone-sourced instrumental groove enters and continues to the end, with no speech or lyrics.

non_diegetic_music: N/A. The music is diegetic, originating from her headphones and heard from her listening perspective.
